title: Finite field base changes over a regular complete coefficient domain
statement: Let A be a complete regular local domain with fraction field K, and C a complete Noetherian local A-algebra whose local structure map is formally smooth for its maximal-ideal-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Then for every finite field extension L/K with compatible A-action, L tensor_A C [def-weil-module-base-change] is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme].

source.place: Proposition Tag 07PM, proof of (4) => (1), coefficient reduction and final two paragraphs; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07PM

proof.text: Apply 07NQ to the local structure map A -> C for flatness and geometric regularity of the quotient closed fibre. Take the trivial extension of its residue field using 0381; tensor identity gives a regular closed fibre. Locality follows because m_A C lies in m_C. Regularity plus locality makes it regular local (Mathlib IsRegularLocalRing.of_isRegularRing_of_isLocalRing).
Apply flat regular-local ascent 031E, then 0AFS, to make C regular.

The generic fibre K tensor_A C is Noetherian by localization base change. For every finite purely inseparable E/K, the proved purely inseparable lemma makes E tensor_A C regular. Tensor cancellation identifies it with E tensor_K (K tensor_A C), so the generic fibre is geometrically regular.
For any finite L/K, 0381 makes L tensor_K (K tensor_A C) regular. Its field extension is finitely generated by Module.Finite. Tensor cancellation gives L tensor_A C.
